verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager and build tool, and such a product could plausibly ship a natural-language or AI command interface, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only a conventional CLI (nix build, nix develop, nix search, nix repl) and the declarative Nix language. Nothing in the pack shows natural-language operation, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
